City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 20, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the December 8, 2020 Special City Council Meeting, December 9, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session Meeting, December 9, 2020 Regular Meeting, December 16, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session, and the December 16, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-01-20 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
Approve the Warrants.
2021-01-20 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Encina Wastewater Authority Board Appointments. Contact Person: Executive Assistant Clisby
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-05, appointing two representatives and one alternate representative to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority
2021-01-20 Item 08C Encina Wastewater Authority Board Appointment
8D.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the Community Resource Center to provide a pilot program for Integrated Senior Services. Contact Person: Center Manager Goodsell
Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, between the City of Encinitas and the Community Resource Center (CRC) to provide a pilot program for Integrated Senior Services to seniors 50 and older in cooperation with the Encinitas Senior Center.
2021-01-20 Item 08D Community Resource Center MOU for Integrated Senior Services
8E.
Contract award for Recreation Guide Production Services. Contact Person: Special Events and Projects Supervisor Buck
Authorize the City Manager to execute a 17-month agreement with one 24-month renewal option between the City of Encinitas and PrintingCEO, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report for a total contract not to exceed $217,880 for graphic design, print layout, printing and bulk mail preparation services for the Recreation Guide.
2021-01-20 Item 08E Award of Contract for Recreation Guide Production Services
8F.
FY 2020-21 Annual Citywide Pavement Rehabilitation, Slurry and Overlay Project (CS21A). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
1) Reject all bids from the December 3, 2020 bid opening for the FY2020-21 Annual Citywide Pavement Rehabilitation, Slurry and Overlay Project (CS21A); and 2) Authorize staff to re-advertise and rebid the FY2020-21 Annual Citywide Pavement Rehabilitation, Slurry and Overlay Project (CS21A).
2021-01-20 Item 08F Reject all Bids and Authorize to Rebid FY20-21 Annual Citywide Pavement Project (CS21A)
8G.
Authorization to award a Five-Year Agreement for Managed Print Services. Contact Person: IT Project Manager Salmon
1) Approve upgrading the City of Encinitas hardware printer/scanner fleet and software through managed print services; 2) Authorize the City Manager to enter into a Phase 1 Managed Print Services contract with Kyocera Document Solutions, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report for a not-to-exceed amount of $61,100 in FY 2020-21 and a not-to-exceed amount annually of $54,200 in FY 2021-22 through FY 2024-25, for a project total not to exceed $277,900; and 3) Authorize participation on NASPO ValuePoint Cooperative Agreement #140599, California Participating Addendum #7-19-70-46-04 for a not-to-exceed amount of $61,100 in FY2020-21 and a not-to-exceed amount annually of $54,200 in FY2021-22 through FY2024-25.
2021-01-20 Item 08G Managed Print Services 5-Year Lease
8H.
Public Beach Restoration Grant from the State of California Department of Parks and Recreation, Division of Boating and Waterways (DBW), to support construction funds for the San Diego County Coastal Storm Damage Reduction Project. Contact Person: Coastal Zone Administrator Timberlake
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-07 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) authorizing submittal of a joint application with the City of Solana Beach for a Public Beach Restoration Grant to the State of California Department of Parks and Recreation, Division of Boating and Waterways; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to negotiate and execute the grant agreement and any amendments necessary to comply with the Division of Boating and Waterways grant requirements.
2021-01-20 Item 08H Public Beach Restoration Grant
8I.
Ratification of amendments to the Memorandum of Agreement with the County of San Diego Health and Human Services Agency and the Memorandum of Understanding with the Community Resource Center for the Temporary Emergency Motel Voucher Program for the COVID-19 response for emergency non-congregate sheltering to extend the program through March 31, 2021. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Ratify the amendment to the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the City of Encinitas and the County of San Diego signed by the City Manager/Director of Emergency Services to provide hotel rooms for “high-risk” individuals that are experiencing homelessness during the COVID-19 pandemic to extend the term from December 30, 2020 to March 31, 2021; and 2) Ratify the amendment to the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Community Resource Center (CRC) signed by the City Manager/Director of Emergency Services to provide case management services for the current “high-risk” individuals utilizing temporary lodging at a cost not-to-exceed $350 per week ($50 per room per week) for seven rooms from December 30, 2020 through March 31, 2021. The costs for case management would not apply to those individuals participating in the Opening Doors or Homeless Prevention and Intervention Fund Programs, which is currently seven of the 14 remaining households.
2021-01-20 Item 08I Motel Voucher Extension
8J.
Recreational Trail Segment Name Change Request. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
Recommend City Council approve the proposed name change request by the Encinitas Trails Coalition for a segment of Stratford Trail to be renamed Cactus Pass (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-01-20 Item 08J Trail Segment Name Change Request
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS - Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10A.
Public Hearing to consider a timely-filed appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of the Newcastle Place project to subdivide 12 underlying lots into four lots, demolish all existing structures on the site, construct two new retail/office buildings with two-stories over a subterranean basement garage and one above ground parking lot, authorize associated grading, site and landscaping improvements, allow two temporary construction trailers for the project, and establish a new sign program for the development.
CASE NUMBER: MULTI-002607-2018; DR-002609-2018; CDPNF-002608-2018 & SUB-003966-2020 (No. 18-175 TPM/DR/CDP)18-175 TM/DR/CDP; APPLICANT: Craig Carlson; APPELLANT: Darren Quinn; LOCATION: 2027 and 2041 Newcastle Avenue (APNs: 260-370-14-00 and 260-370-06-00). Contact Person: Senior Planner II Innes
Deny the appeal and adopt the attached draft City Council Resolution No. 2021-01 (Attachment CC-1) upholding the decision of the Planning Commission to approve the project with conditions of approval.

Overview and analysis of programming and resource needs for SB 1383 Compliance. Contact Persons: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock and Management Analyst Stratakis
Receive staff report and provide input and/or direction to staff.
2021-01-20 Item 10B SB 1383 Compliance
10C.
Presentation of the City's Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2020. Contact Person: Finance Manger Huang
Accept and file the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2020.
2021-01-20 Item 10C Presentation of the City's CAFR for the FY Ended June 30, 2020
2021-01-20 Item 10C Presentation of the City's CAFR - Davis Farr Presentation

10D.
Discussion and action regarding options for filling the District 3 Council seat vacated by District 3 Council Member Jody Hubbard. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Council to discuss and provide direction to staff regarding filling the District 3 Council vacancy.
2021-01-20 Item 10D Council Vacancy

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
